done_when: Added explicit rule to LLM system prompt: 'Do NOT call text_to_speech when calling show_media for a single recognized subject.' Updated tool description in both providers. All LLM tests pass.

description: Investigate and fix 'Service temporarily unavailable' errors
done_when: Root cause: WebSocket error handler always set type='server', which mapped to generic message. Fix: changed to type='client' so backend error messages (transcription failed, etc.) pass through to user. LEARNINGS.md entry added.

description: Reduce 'No speech detected' error spam
done_when: Backend silently ignores empty transcripts instead of sending error. Frontend HTTP path silently resets to idle. Tests updated in both backend and frontend.

description: Close WebSocket when microphone is tapped off
done_when: stopWebSocketRecording() now calls wsClient.disconnect() after stopRecording(). WebSocket closes when mic tapped off, returns to idle. Next recording tap reconnects. Tests updated.

description: Switch audio transport from raw binary to base64-encoded JSON messages
done_when: Frontend sendAudioChunk sends JSON {type:audio_data, data:<base64>, seq, client_time}. Backend handleAudioDataMessage decodes base64 and buffers audio. Legacy binary path preserved for backward compat. 3 new backend tests + 5 updated frontend tests pass.

description: Fix fetch-feedback.py cursor behavior - always update .feedback-cursor
done_when: Cursor advances past filtered-out items using all_newest_ts computed before trust filtering. When all items filtered, cursor still updates. max(newest_ts, all_newest_ts) used for written items. No re-fetch of already-seen items.

description: Add user_id to feedback records and admin API response
done_when: Feedback struct has UserID *string. Schema has user_id column + ALTER TABLE migration. FeedbackHandler extracts user_id from session. Admin API includes user_id in response. 2 new DB tests + all existing tests pass.

description: Add io.LimitReader to JSON decode success paths for external API responses

All backend tests pass.
